name: io.github.yourappspace/yourappspace-mcp
description: MCP server for YourAppSpace Core — Visual Schema Designer, Data Grid UI, REST APIs, and Row/Field-Level Security for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ENTITY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full base URL of your YourAppSpace instance (e.g. https://core.yourappspace.com or http://localhost:8080)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ENTITY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Full user API key with the ip_api_key_ prefix (sent in X-Auth header)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ENTITY_USER
environmentVariables.description: Authorized user email/username (fallback when MCP_ENTITY_API_KEY is omitted)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ENTITY_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Account password (fallback when MCP_ENTITY_API_KEY is omitted)
